segments.text: To begin with, a contained laboratory uses directional airflow to control a pathogen within
segments.zh: 首先，防护实验室利用定向气流把病原体控制在

segments.text: a confined space.
segments.zh: 一个受限空间内。

segments.text: This is the primary concept of containment.
segments.zh: 这是防护的首要概念。

segments.text: I am now in what is known as an airlock.
segments.zh: 我现在位于所谓的气闸室中。

segments.text: So this is basically a region in the laboratory in which we have positive pressure.
segments.zh: 这基本上是实验室中保持正压的一个区域。

segments.text: Positive pressure basically keeps any air out from this area on either side.
segments.zh: 正压基本上可以阻止任何一侧的空气进入这个区域。

segments.text: So if you look on this side, if you follow the video, this is the external environment
segments.zh: 如果你看这一侧，跟着视频看，这里是外部环境，

segments.text: and we look on this side and this side is basically the area which is under containment.
segments.zh: 再看这一侧，这一侧基本上就是处于防护之下的区域。

segments.text: Now this area can be compared to an air curtain at a supermarket entrance.
segments.zh: 这个区域可以比作超市入口处的风幕。

segments.text: The air basically is a downdraft which locks in the pathogen in the containment zone.
segments.zh: 这里的空气基本上是一股向下的气流，把病原体锁在防护区内。

segments.text: I will now proceed to the next zone.
segments.zh: 现在我进入下一个区域。

segments.text: So the next zone is maintained at a negative pressure.
segments.zh: 下一个区域保持负压。

segments.text: This negative pressure ensures that air will enter into this zone.
segments.zh: 负压可以确保空气流入这个区域。

segments.text: However when it is filtered out for release into the environment, it will be passed through
segments.zh: 不过，当空气被抽出排放到环境中时，要经过

segments.text: a high efficiency particulate filter.
segments.zh: 高效颗粒过滤器。

segments.text: This filter will filter out most of the pathogens by trapping them in a matrix.
segments.zh: 这种过滤器会把大部分病原体截留在滤材中，从而将其滤除。

segments.text: Basically the filter has 0.22 micron size.
segments.zh: 基本上，这种过滤器的孔径是 0.22 微米。

segments.text: So essentially all pathogens and particulates are trapped in the filter.
segments.zh: 所以基本上所有的病原体和颗粒物都会被截留在过滤器中。

segments.text: Now this zone is at negative pressure.
segments.zh: 这个区域处于负压状态。

segments.text: In a negative pressure zone, the air is directed towards filters which are located in the ceiling.
segments.zh: 在负压区内，空气被导向位于天花板上的过滤器。

segments.text: So the air flows through this, through the ceiling, through a heat power filter before
segments.zh: 空气从这里流过，穿过天花板，经过高效空气过滤器，然后

segments.text: it exits into the external environment.
segments.zh: 才排放到外部环境中。

segments.text: This is referred to in biorisk management as an engineering control.
segments.zh: 在生物风险管理中，这被称为工程控制。

segments.text: Engineering controls based on directional air flow are a common component in all biological
segments.zh: 基于定向气流的工程控制是所有生物

segments.text: safety laboratories.
segments.zh: 安全实验室的常见组成部分。

segments.text: So as we progress through the laboratory, the directional air flow will continue to drop.
segments.zh: 随着我们在实验室中逐步深入，定向气流的压力会不断降低。

segments.text: For example, we have entered at this location and the pressure is negative here.
segments.zh: 例如，我们从这个位置进来，这里是负压。

segments.text: So as I proceed into the suites of the laboratories areas, the pressure will keep
segments.zh: 当我继续走进实验室的各个区域套间时，压力会不断

segments.text: dropping to a lower and lower negative pressure zone.
segments.zh: 下降，进入负压越来越低的区域。

segments.text: This is the way in which pathogens are confined to this region of the laboratory.
segments.zh: 病原体就是通过这种方式被限制在实验室的这个区域内的。

segments.text: So all the work involving pathogens, such as diagnostics and experiments, takes place
segments.zh: 所有涉及病原体的工作，比如诊断和实验，都在

segments.text: in these three suites.
segments.zh: 这三个套间中进行。

segments.text: They are under negative pressure as compared to the zone at which I am standing in right
segments.zh: 与我现在所站的区域相比，

segments.text: now.
segments.zh: 它们都处于负压状态。

segments.text: This is the way in which an engineering control is applied at this facility to contain microbes
segments.zh: 这就是本设施运用工程控制把微生物控制在

segments.text: to the respective laboratories and working areas.
segments.zh: 各自的实验室和工作区域内的方式。

segments.text: This is the basic concept of containment.
segments.zh: 这就是防护的基本概念。

segments.text: Thank you very much for watching.
segments.zh: 非常感谢观看。
